_readme: WHAT THIS IS  One entry per working day: what shipped, what is next, what you
were thinking. The devlog (docs/devlog.md) is the human-readable
narrative; this is its machine-readable twin, and the two must
READ BY       hooks/session-start-producer-check.sh (reads the newest entry's
top entry and the registry's current focus).
SEEDED BY     the installer's scaffold step. entries is empty on day one; the
next       : 'one line — the immediate next action'
_edit_policy: Append a new dated key per session; never rewrite history. 'next' and 'thoughts' are designer-owned — a skill may propose changes to them but must ask first.
